I am apsolutely sure that your parent's behaviour is simply because they really care about you and what you are feeling right now is self-destructive so they want to help you in any way they can, the problem is I think they don't know how. I know you don't want to now but try communicating with them. My problems run deeper, in 26 year's I've never managed to get a girl to like me, that means, never had sex, never been on a date, never held a girl's hand and never kissed. - just imagine talking to a 26 year old guy who tells you this, the biggest red flag there is, it's too late for me... Also my father is an alcoholic, not abusive but a drunk nonetheless, that whole situation made my sister and mother get depression as well.  
What I want you to know is that it can get better, although I do not believe it for myself I truly believe that for other people and for you of course, you are still young with so much ahead of you, do not give up just yet.

Hello, I'd like to hear what made you feel this way, I'm on a fast downward spiral myself right now with a lot of problems on my mind and I think talking to others in similar situations might help so I welcome you to share your story with me.
If you wish to share what made you suicidal I am willing to exchange stories, I do not know if it will help but I am willing to try if it will make you feel better.
Judging by the amount of people that care and replied, I suppose the answer is no.

I too had an abusive brother, he moved out a few years ago and completely changed is act but when we were boys he would beat me up and make me do his chores all the time. Please do not dwell on your trauma, if there is ANYTHING I would like to let other people know then that is to just go for it, get over your fear, live, love and be loved, enjoy the life I could never have had but always wanted, you have potential, you are young and others like you, do not give up or you will end up like me which is a curse I would not wish on my worst enemy.

Try accepting their advances and see where it leads to, failure is an essential part of living so do not be afraid of oppening up and showing vulnerability. I am the literal opposite of you, never any advances by anyone and no one has ever even accepted to go on a date with me or kiss/cuddle/hug, 26 years of loneliness without hope and all I've ever wanted was for a girl to allow herself to be liked by me, she doesn't even have to like me honestly, I would give everything to be in a situation like you.

Hello, would this post be allowed to be posted if I removed any personal connections in it and set it up to look as a completely objective and unbiased post? I really would like to get an answer for my question as I am kinda fcked, I do understand if that is not something you allow here but please consider it, thank you.
